SELECT po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pod.sku_no, round(SUM(pod.purchase_amount) / COUNT(pod.id)::numeric ,4) AS avgPrice, COUNT(pod.id) AS orderQty, SUM(pod.purchase_amount) AS orderAmount FROM purchase_order_detail pod LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pod.purchase_order_id = po.id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON pos.purchase_order_id = po.id AND po.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pos.is_deleted = FALSE
and po.purchase_date >= #{params.billDateList[0]} and (#{params.billDateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) >= po.purchase_date
GROUP BY po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pod.sku_no
